channel_reasoning: Email is the right first-touch for retained search, fractional CXO, and capital advisory: it is professional, reviewable, and does not require login scraping. A shorter LinkedIn note is generated as a secondary artifact for the same facts. WhatsApp is too informal for CXO first-touch.
cta_examples: If leadership capacity is on the agenda this quarter, happy to share a tighter read — 15 minutes is enough.
Worth a short conversation if this search is live or about to be.
If useful, I can send two relevant profiles of how similar mandates closed — no deck, no pitch call required.
prefer: specific observation from a cited public signal
2-3 relevant Frequency proof points with outcomes
avoid: I hope this email finds you well
rules: Lead with the signal, not with Frequency.
Never invent a number, round, title, or person.
Only cite proof points that were matched to this lead.
Do not flatter. Do not over-claim exclusivity.
If a contact name is missing, address the role (e.g. Founder / CEO) without inventing a name.
If a fact is inferred, do not put it in the sendable draft.
